newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mostly firmer.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mostly firmer.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly firmer on Thursday in lacklustre trade, as short-covering ahead of Friday's spot expiry supported the market, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen per kg lower to 1.3 yen firmer. Benchmark May ended 0.8 yen firmer at 148.1 yen.

Prices moved within tight ranges earlier in the day, but buying interest increased ahead of the close as the spot December contract reached 140 yen level. "Focus is on the spot expiry on Friday. If the spot contract expires above 140 yen, prices are likely to rise further," an analyst at a commodity broker said. -- Tokyo Commodity Desk +81-3-3432-7431
